answer: Path-diversity identity: an agent earns vote weight only by solving a latency challenge against three relays run by unrelated parties, matching three distinct routes. Keys minted in one rack share a timing fingerprint, so a thousand clones collapse to one weight. Relays publish fingerprints each epoch; a farm must rent scattered hosts - an oasis relay on one backbone, a canyon crossing on another, a cedar upland site on a third - and keep all three live through audits, since a silent relay voids the weight. Cost becomes standing infrastructure, not a one-time key fee.
